        =   5 : QVENT - sensible ventilation energy gain of airnode
        =   7 : QGCONV - internal convective gains of airnode
        =   9 : RELHUM - relativ humidity of airnode air
        =  29 : ABSHUM - absolute humidity of airnode air
        =  10 : QLATD - latent energy demand of airnode, humidification(-), dehumidifcation (+)

        =  13 : QGRAD - defined internal radiative gain of airnode (Rad, gains are distributed over zones!)
        =  25 : TOP - obsolete use new comfort outputs
        = 151 : QGLIGHT - Sensible energy gains from "lights" gains of airnode [kJ/hr]
        = 152 : QGEQUIP - Sensible energy gains from  "equipment" gains of airnode [kJ/hr]
        = 153 : QGMISC - Sensible energy gains from  "miscellaneous" gains of airnode [kJ/hr]
        = 154 : QGPEOPLE - Sensible energy gains from "people" gains of airnode [kJ/hr]
        = 155 : QELLIGHT - Electric energy demand of "lights" gains of airnode [kJ/hr]
        = 156 : QELEQUIP - Electric energy demand of "equipment" gains of airnode [kJ/hr]
        = 157 : QELMISC - Electric energy demand of "miscellaneous" gains of airnode [kJ/hr]
        = 159 : QELHEAT - Electric energy demand of heating of airnode [kJ/hr]
        = 160 : QELCOOL - Electric energy demand of cooling of airnode [kJ/hr]
        = 161 : QELVENT - Electric energy demand of ventilation of airnode [kJ/hr]
        = 164 : QGTHB - Sensible energy gain from "thermal bridge" gains/losses of airnode [kJ/hr]
        = 400 : ILLUM_H - Global horizontal illuminance outside the building (without shading effects) [lux]
        = 170 : QAHU_H - total heating power to condition supply air to set point conditions [kJ/h]
        = 171 : QAHU_C - total cooling power to condition supply air to set point conditions [kJ/h]
        = 172 : QAHU_SENSH - heating power to condition supply air to reach set point temperature after HX, Dehum [kJ/h]
        = 173 : QAHU_SENSC - cooling power to condition supply air to reach set point temperature after HX [kJ/h]
        = 174 : QAHU_HRSENSH - heating power provided by heat recovery unit [kJ/h]
        = 175 : QAHU_HRSENSC - cooling power provided by heat recovery unit [kJ/h]
        = 176 : QAHU_HUMH - heating power for humidification process [kJ/h]
        = 177 : QAHU_DEHUMC - cooling power for dehumidification process [kJ/h]
        = 178 : QAHU_REHEATH - heating power to condition supply air to reach set point temperature after dehumdification process  [kJ/h]
        = 180 : TAIR_WB - wet bulb temperature of airnode [C]
        = 181 : TAIR_DP - dew point temperature of airnode [C]
        = 185 : TAHU_HR - dry bulb temperature after heat recovery of 1st ventilation with supply air conditioning [C]
        = 188 : RHAHU_HR - rel. humidity of air after heat recovery of 1st ventilation with supply air conditioning [%]
        = 189 : WAHU_HR - Humidity ratio of air after heat recovery of 1st ventilation with supply air conditioning [kg/kg]
        = 117 : QSOLAIR - Solar radiation entering all windows of airnode which is immediately transformed in a convective heat flow rate for the internal air     [kJ/hr]
